title: CollectionPurgeReport
description: Body of DELETE /v1/collections/{collection_id}?purge=true. A purge touches four independent systems (the registry binding, the Qdrant collection, the Elasticsearch index, the provenance manifest) that can each succeed, be already-gone, or fail on their own, so the outcome is three lists rather than a boolean — that is what makes a partial failure reportable instead of a 500 that hides the deletions which did land. Nothing is ever rolled back. Target names: registry | vectors | text_index | manifest.

collection_id.description: The registry id that was purged.

purged.description: Always true in this body; a purge=false delete returns 204 with no body.

store.description: Physical Qdrant collection name the purge targeted.

text_index.description: Physical Elasticsearch index name the purge targeted (defaults to the same name as `store`).

absent.description: Targets that were already gone. Idempotent no-op, not an error — purging twice is safe.

failed.description: Targets that errored. NOT rolled back: the physical resource may still exist and needs cleaning up by hand.

error.description: The backend's own message, prefixed with the exception type.

ok.description: True when `failed` is empty — the collection and all of its data are fully gone.
